recipes.name: Squash and Beef inspired by It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia
ingredients: For the Babish Squash and Beef
1 tbsp five spice powder, toasted + ground
As needed freshly ground black pepper
instructions: For the Babish Squash and Beef
Season the short ribs with salt, then let them rest at room temperature for 30 minutes. - 4 large short ribs - As needed kosher salt
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. - 1 tbsp neutral oil divided
Add the onion to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes or until lightly caramelized. - 1 yellow onion roughly chopped

Add the ginger, garlic, chili paste, and five-spice to the pan. Stir to combine and cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until fragrant. - 1 inch knob ginger peeled + grated - 1 garlic clove minced - 1 tsp fermented chili paste - 1 tbsp five spice powder toasted + ground

Deglaze the pan with red wine. Add the chicken stock, brown sugar, soy sauce, and Worcestershire sauce, then bring the sauce to a simmer. - 1 ½ cup dry red wine - 1 ½ cup chicken stock preferably homemade - 2 tbsp brown sugar - ⅓ cup soy sauce - ⅓ cup Worcestershire sauce
Add the prepared short ribs to the skillet. Add water as necessary to make sure they are mostly submerged. - As needed water
Transfer the skillet to the preheated 325°F oven and cook for 2 ½ - 3 hours, or until the short ribs are tender and cooked through. Make sure to flip the short ribs about halfway through cooking.
Meanwhile, set a separate oven to 400°F and place a sheet tray inside to preheat.
Scored the flesh of the butternut squash with a cross-hatch pattern. - 1 butternut squashed seed removed + halved
Coat each half in the remaining tablespoon of oil and season with salt and pepper. - 1 tbsp neutral oil divided - As needed kosher salt - As needed freshly ground black pepper
Transfer the squash halves cut-side down to the preheated sheet tray.
Roast the squash in the preheated 400 °F for 25-30 minutes. Then, flip the squash cut-side up and cook for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until completely tender.

While the squash is still hot, scoop out the flesh and transfer it to the bowl of a food processor. Add about ¼ cup of the browned butter and cream, then while the processor is running, stream in the remaining browned butter. Keep warm until ready to serve. - 16 tbsp browned butter divided - 3 tbsp heavy cream
Once the short ribs are cooked, remove the short ribs and keep warm until ready to serve.
Strain the cooking liquid and skim off any excess fat, and reserve.

Transfer the strained and skimmed cooking liquid to a high-powdered blender. Sprinkle the xanthan gum over the surface of the sauce and begin blending. With the blender running, stream in the reserved fat from the cooking liquid. - ½ tsp xanthan gum
Serve the short ribs and sauce with the browned butter butternut squash puree. Garnish with pea shoot microgreens. - To garnish: pea shoot microgreens
